learning_outcomes.text: To improve students' scientific and technological background to produce higher quality work in MMU I and MMU II (Project) courses, preparing them for projects.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, information about the course's operation, information about knowledge sources and access to them (internet, patent, Google Scholar, online books and databases, etc.)
Information on using the project writing template and project writing language. Explanation of project writing principles and the contents of the sections.

Information about the project topic, its purpose, how it works, and its basic elements. Explanation of the sequential stages of doing the project. Tips for literature review and the project's introduction section. Provision of solid models for the project, if any.
How to draw assembly drawings, information about title blocks, and material lists. Manual drawing and AutoCAD and Solidworks can be used.

Evaluation of some student assembly drawings. How to draw production drawings, their features, and title blocks. Where to give which dimensions and geometric tolerances, surface finish marks, etc. will be covered.
Evaluation of some student production drawings. Bearing problems and solutions. Material selection.
Evaluation of some student production drawings. Bearing problems and solutions. Material selection.
Writing the introductory parts of the project.

Evaluation of the literature review and introduction section of Project 1 for a few students. Duties of the elements. The sequence of assembly and disassembly, how force, moment, and power transmission occur will be explained.

Checking and discussing the work of a few students. Drawing Free Body Diagrams (FBDs) of important elements. Examples of force analysis. Very detailed calculations are not expected. Determining which assembly drawing and which production drawings will be drawn.
Checking and discussing the work of a few students. Information on what and how to write in the preface, abstract, introduction, development, and conclusion sections.
